prepDeadlines.title: GROW Carolina 2027 Evangelism Plan due
prepDeadlines.what: The President's Office requires the GROW Carolina 2027 Evangelism Plan form (Prepare, Plant, Cultivate, Harvest, Preserve plans, 2026 baptism and Bible-study figures, church board approval date) from every church and company, whether or not funding is requested; one form per entity, English or Spanish version, by 30 Nov 2026.
